# Lumos Dental & Aesthetic Clinic, Dubai

> Lumos Dental & Aesthetic Clinic (legal name Lumos Polyclinic L.L.C.) is a DHA-licensed polyclinic on Sheikh Zayed Road, Trade Centre 1, Dubai, providing general and cosmetic dentistry, injectable and regenerative aesthetics, dermatology and laser treatments under one roof.

- Address: Unit 3501, Aspin Commercial Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, Trade Centre 1, Dubai, UAE
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971 4 352 4140
